description: Clara design system components — documented and ready to use

components.name: Button
components.description: Interactive button for primary and secondary actions
components.usage: Use primary for the most important action on a page. Use secondary for supporting actions.
rules: Never create layout variations (e.g., full-width) unless specified
States: use disabled attribute, not .disabled class
Hover and pressed states use overlay tokens

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input field with label and optional helper text

classModifiers.field: HTML input element with disabled attribute

components.usage: Always include a label. Only use placeholder when it helps understand format (e.g., phone number). Helper text is guidance-only.
rules: Never use placeholder as a substitute for label
Helper text only shown when needed
Icons for secondary actions or status only — never decorative
Never add placeholder text unless component spec explicitly shows one

components.name: Checkbox
components.usage: Always include a label. Touch target is 12px padding around entire checkbox.
rules: Label is required — never a label-less checkbox
Touch target minimum 12px padding — never reduce clickable area

components.name: Radio button
components.description: Radio button input with inline label
components.usage: Use for mutually exclusive choices. Always use radio groups (shared name attribute).
rules: All radios in a group must share the same name attribute
Label is required for each radio button

components.name: Option tile
components.description: Large clickable tile for option selection
components.usage: Use for prominent option selection when visual prominence helps the user. Not required for every form.
rules: Can be used with radio or checkbox input type
Larger touch target than radio/checkbox

components.name: Switch
components.usage: Use for immediate on/off toggles. Include a label describing what the switch controls.
rules: Must have descriptive label
Use for boolean states only — not for selecting between options

componentCreationRules.description: When a component doesn't exist in Clara, you may invent one following these rules:
rules: Use ONLY OK's semantic color tokens — never primitives or hardcoded colors
Use ONLY OK family (H1/H2) and Fellix (body/labels/buttons) — never other fonts
Follow OK's visual language — never deviate from the design system
Document the component clearly with HTML and CSS so future AIs can reuse it
Use consistent BEM naming: .clara-component, .clara-component__element, .clara-component--modifier

primitives.description: Base values — red.600, grey.100, space.md, etc.

semantic.description: Named by purpose — color-actions-button-primary-background, spacing-md, etc.

breaskpoints.note: Headings are responsive — scale up on desktop. Body and UI text stay the same.
